name: Urgot
notes: Opens with Fear Beyond Death (R) at t=0 for its upfront physical damage; the recast (Mercy) is not modeled since it is an unconditional execute rather than a computable damage instance and a full-health dummy is unlikely to reliably cross the 25%-remaining threshold within the fight window.
Corrosive Charge (Q) is cast on cooldown; its damage lands after a combined 0.4 s delay (0.1 s missile-launch delay plus the 0.3 s post-landing explosion delay from the numbers sheet), not on cast.

Disdain (E) is cast on cooldown and its dash damage is dealt right after the cast completes (the dash/fling itself is not modeled beyond the usual cast lockout); its shield is defensive-only and not modeled in this damage fight.

Purge (W) is toggled on the instant it is off cooldown and kept running: each activation fires shots every 1/3 s (3.0 fixed attacks/second) for its rank's duration, which yields 13 shots pre-max-rank (floor(4 x 3) + 1) and an effectively unbroken stream at max rank (its 25000 s sentinel duration and 0 s cooldown/cost). Urgot's normal attack timer is paused for the whole activation, matching Purge overriding his autoattacks; the post-effect cooldown starts when the activation ends.

Purge bypasses the engine's normal basic-attack loop, so generic item on-hit effects are not applied to its shots; its own listed per-shot damage and Echoing Flames are still modeled. Spellblade/Muramana's on-cast proc and Eclipse are triggered once per Purge activation (treating the activation itself as the ability cast), not once per shot, since those procs are on-cast rather than on-hit effects here.

Echoing Flames (P): since a stationary single target never leaves the arc of more than one of Urgot's six legs, it is modeled as a single recurring charge on the per-level per-leg cooldown, triggered by the next basic attack (including Purge shots) that lands while it is up. During Purge, its damage is reduced to the ability's 50% on-hit effectiveness, matching the wiki's stated reduction for on-hit/on-attack effects while Purge is firing; at full attacks it is unreduced.
Mana is not modeled: Urgot's level-16 mana pool comfortably covers R once, a handful of Q/E casts and W's low/zero cost within a 15 s fight.
